subject: ClearWave: private deployment feasibility + non-standard requirements
messages:
From: Maria Aguinaldo <maria@clearwavehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearwavehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Private deployment feasibility — nonstandard asks + timeline

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the product tour last week. We’ve completed an internal checklist and have a few nonstandard items that are blockers for our security/compliance team if we move forward with a private VPC/on‑prem rollout: 

- HSM-backed key storage (customer keys must never leave our control)
- Local audit logs stored on customer-managed S3 (not forwarded to Redwood)
- No external outbound access from inference hosts except to monitoring endpoints we approve
- A short pilot (6 weeks) that must not impact our production environment and needs a rollback playbook

I attached our requirements doc (clearwave_requirements_v1.pdf). Target launch window they gave us is mid‑November. Can your team confirm whether these are feasible and what resourcing/lead time we should plan for?

Appreciate your help — Maria

--
Maria Aguinaldo
Director, IT Security
ClearWave Health
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Maria Aguinaldo <maria@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment feasibility — nonstandard asks + timeline

Hi Maria — thanks for the detailed list and the doc. I’ve looped in Karthik (arch), Kimberly (ops), and Priyom (product) to assess feasibility and give a realistic timeline and resource ask.

High level next steps from our side:
1) Arch feasibility note (by Karthik): confirm kernel/HSM integration path and outbound network constraints.
2) Ops pilot plan (by Kimberly): minimal blast radius pilot runbook + rollback checklist + resource (SRE) support.
3) Product gating items (by Priyom): any functionality we’d need to deprioritize for the pilot.

We’ll get a consolidated assessment by EOD Wednesday 29 Sep. If that works, I’ll schedule a 30‑minute sync Thurs for a decision checkpoint with your security and procurement teams.

Rachel
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Maria Aguinaldo <maria@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment feasibility — nonstandard asks + timeline

Rachel / Maria — quick technical assessment below. I skimmed the attached requirements and sketched a pilot plan (pilot_vm_sizing.xlsx attached).

Summary: feasible with caveats and resource lead time.

- HSM: We can integrate an HSM (cloud KMS or customer HSM) but it requires 3 engineering weeks for a hardened KMS connector + co-signed key rotation workflow. If ClearWave insists on customer-managed HSM appliances in‑datacenter, add procurement and network setup time (2–3 weeks) and an ops validation window.

- Audit logs: supporting local-only audit logs is straightforward. We'll need a configuration toggle and a retention policy doc. Note: local S3 endpoints must support S3-compatible auth we can validate during pilot.

- Network egress restrictions: we can implement deny-by-default egress rules for pilot hosts; however, monitoring/health checks need to be whitelisted to a small set of endpoints. That requires a change to our deployment automation (approx 1 week).

- Rollback/playbook: we can provide a rollback runbook and snapshot-based rollback for the pilot, ops will need 1 dedicated SRE on call during pilot.

Resource/time estimate for a 6‑week pilot (calendar days):
- Engineering (runtime/arch): 2 engineers x 3 weeks (6 engineer‑weeks)
- Platform/SRE: 1 SRE full time for pilot prep + on-call during pilot (approx 4 weeks prep + 6 weeks on-call)
- Security review & validation: 1 security engineer 1 week
- Ops automation for egress + audit toggle: 1 engineer x 1 week

Blocking questions for ClearWave:
1) Do you require an on‑prem HSM appliance (Y/N)? If yes, who owns procurement and physical network?
2) Can you provide a short list of outbound monitoring endpoints we can whitelist?
3) Is there an internal compliance reviewer who will validate the pilot artifacts during the prep week?

I attached pilot_vm_sizing.xlsx with an example footprint to help ops size the hosts.

-Karthik
Senior Staff Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Maria Aguinaldo <maria@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 14:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment feasibility — nonstandard asks + timeline

Thanks Karthik — adding ops perspective and estimated cost/coverage.

Pilot ops ask list:
- Dedicated pilot GP/instances for isolation (we recommend 3 nodes)
- 1 SRE assigned to runbook prep + on-call (as Karthik noted)
- Security validation window (3 business days) before pilot go/no-go

Rough cost impact (pilot 6 weeks):
- Infra: ~$18k (bare metal/GPU reservation depending on chosen instance type)
- SRE time + runbook prep: ~$12k
- Engineering contingency (integrations / HSM work): ~$8k

Total estimated budget: ~$38k (pilot). If ClearWave needs us to absorb any of that as a pilot credit we can consider a limited credit tied to a committed Dedicated contract. Marissa — tagging you for pricing/discount guidance.

Action items:
1) Maria: confirm HSM appliance requirement and outbound endpoint list.
2) Rachel: propose Thurs sync time; I’ll prepare a short pilot runbook stub and attach the MALICENOTE-sample-audit.log.txt that shows the log format for compliance review.

Kim
Head of Platform Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Maria Aguinaldo <maria@clearwavehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment feasibility — nonstandard asks + timeline

Looping in pricing decision: we can offer a pilot credit of up to $20k tied to a 12‑month Dedicated commit and term sheet to follow. Deal team note: attach HubSpot deal DW-4821 and procurement contact info. Rachel — please confirm whether ClearWave will consider a Dedicated commit after pilot or require a non‑committal PoC.

Also, if ClearWave confirms they do NOT need an on‑prem HSM appliance (i.e., will accept a customer‑managed cloud KMS), we can shorten lead time by ~2 weeks.

Marissa
VP Sales — Redwood Inference
